Cave_Bear_Fungus_Tendrils.description: Emerging from the dark recesses of the caverns, the Cave_Bear_Fungus_Tendrils are a grotesque amalgamation of ursine flesh and pulsating fungal tendrils, granting the creature unparalleled strength and reach, as well as the ability to scale sheer surfaces with ease.

Swamp_Bear_Root_Sprouts.description: Emerging from the mire, the Swamp_Bear_Root_Sprouts are ghostly tendrils that coalesce into a dense, bear-like form, their appendages shifting fluidly between sturdy limbs and sinuous tentacles, granting them unparalleled stealth and the ability to scale sheer surfaces with ease.

Eldritch_Bear_Maw_Tentacles.description: Emerging from the shadowy depths of the forest, the Eldritch Bear Maw Tentacles are unsettling appendages that combine the brute strength and intimidation of a bear with arcane magic, granting their wielder an extended reach and a commanding presence that can both grapple foes and instill fear.

Mutated_Bear_Antler_Vines.description: The Mutated Bear Antler Vines are a grotesque fusion of nature and dark magic, with thick, sinuous tentacles sprouting from gnarled ursine antlers that pulse with an unsettling charisma, granting their bearer a fearsome reach and an eerie ability to charm foes.

Sea_Bear_Anemone_Crown.description: The Sea_Bear_Anemone_Crown is a bizarre amalgamation of ursine and marine life, with thick, fleshy tentacles sprouting from its neck like an anemone's tentacles, enhancing its swimming prowess and granting it an eerie, heightened perception of its surroundings and the ability to sense vibrations in the water.

Corrupted_Bear_Shadow_Tendrils.description: From the shadows emerge twisted, shadowy tendrils that coalesce around the corrupted bear, granting it an otherworldly grace and an eerie ability to blend into the darkness, its intelligence sharpened by the arcane energies it wields.

Alien_Bear_Light_Tentacles.description: Emerging from the shadowy depths of a forgotten dimension, the Alien_Bear_Light_Tentacles entity floats with otherworldly grace, its slender, luminous appendages undulating with a life of their own as it senses and manipulates the arcane energies around it, granting it an uncanny awareness and a deadly touch.

Biotech_Bear_Cable_Extenders.description: Sinister tendrils sprout from the bear’s armored limbs, blending mechanical precision with feral grace, enhancing its dexterity and reach to ensnare foes with eerie efficiency.

Zombie_Bear_Exposed_Intestines.description: The Zombie_Bear_Exposed_Intestines component transforms the creature into a grotesque amalgamation of rotting flesh and writhing tentacles, its once-majestic form now a toxic nightmare that emits a poisonous cloud and can ensnare foes with its ghastly appendages.

Ghost_Bear_Ectoplasmic_Tendrils.description: The Ghost Bear's Ectoplasmic Tendrils are ghostly, semi-translucent appendages that curl and twist like living shadows, granting the bear an otherworldly grace and the ability to move silently through the ether, its magical essence granting it a supernatural reach and wisdom beyond its spectral form.
